achievements.summaryEn: Awarded when your opened pull requests get merged. Tiered by how many of your PRs have been merged: 2 (default), 16 (Bronze x2), 128 (Silver x3), 1024 (Gold x4).
achievements.summaryZh: 你发起的拉取请求被合并后即可获得。等级按已合并 PR 数量递增：2（默认）、16（青铜 x2）、128（白银 x3）、1024（黄金 x4）。
achievements.descriptionEn: Pull Shark celebrates sustained contribution through pull requests. GitHub's own badge history on every profile lists the exact milestone pull request for each level, phrased as '2nd pull request merged', '16th pull request merged', '128th pull request merged' and '1024th pull request merged'. That is what makes the four thresholds directly verifiable from GitHub's own data rather than community guesswork. The badge artwork changes per level and the tier is shown as a small x2/x3/x4 label. Verified live on torvalds (Bronze), ljharb (Gold), timrogers (Gold), dylanatsmith (Gold), Schweinepriester (Silver), brannon (Silver) and Rongronggg9 (Silver). Note that merged PRs in private repositories and in your own repositories do count, contrary to a widely repeated belief that only public PRs count.
achievements.descriptionZh: Pull Shark 用于表彰通过拉取请求持续贡献的行为。GitHub 自己会在每个用户档案的徽章历史中逐级列出触发该等级的 PR，文字形如「2nd pull request merged」「16th pull request merged」「128th pull request merged」「1024th pull request merged」——这正是四个门槛可以直接从 GitHub 官方数据中验证、而非社区猜测的原因。徽章图片随等级变化，等级以 x2/x3/x4 的小标签显示。已在 torvalds（青铜）、ljharb（黄金）、timrogers（黄金）、dylanatsmith（黄金）、Schweinepriester（白银）、brannon（白银）、Rongronggg9（白银）等真实账号上验证。注意：私有仓库以及你自己名下仓库中被合并的 PR 同样计入，这与「只有公开 PR 才算」这一流传很广的说法相反。
achievements.conditionEn: GitHub's own wording (from the live badge detail): "@<user> opened pull requests that have been merged." Milestones named by GitHub in the badge history: the 2nd, 16th, 128th and 1024th merged pull request. Default threshold 2, Bronze 16, Silver 128, Gold 1024.
achievements.conditionZh: GitHub 官方措辞（来自徽章详情页）：「@<用户名> opened pull requests that have been merged.」GitHub 在徽章历史中明确标注触发各等级的里程碑：第 2、16、128、1024 个被合并的拉取请求。默认门槛 2，青铜 16，白银 128，黄金 1024。

tiers.note: Confirmed directly from GitHub's live badge history text '2nd pull request merged' (torvalds, ljharb, timrogers, dylanatsmith, brannon, Schweinepriester, Rongronggg9 and ~54 harvested profiles).
Confirmed from GitHub's live badge history text '16th pull request merged'; GitHub labels the unlock 'Bronze' and the badge tier label reads x2.
Confirmed from GitHub's live badge history text '128th pull request merged'; tier label reads x3.
Confirmed from GitHub's live badge history text '1024th pull request merged' (ljharb, timrogers, dylanatsmith); tier label reads x4.

achievements.confidenceNote: Every threshold is quoted verbatim from GitHub's own live badge-history endpoint (/users/<user>/achievements/pull-shark/detail), which lists the triggering PR per tier. No community inference needed.

achievements.summaryEn: Awarded when a repository you created reaches 16 stars. Tiers: 16 (default), 128 (Bronze x2), 512 (Silver x3), 4096 (Gold x4) stars on one repository.
achievements.summaryZh: 你创建的仓库获得 16 颗 star 时解锁。等级：16（默认）、128（青铜 x2）、512（白银 x3）、4096（黄金 x4）颗 star，且作用于同一个仓库。
achievements.descriptionEn: Starstruck recognizes repositories you created that other developers find valuable enough to star. GitHub's live badge history names the star thresholds explicitly, showing rows like '16 stars', '128 stars', '512 stars' and '4096 stars', and each row links to the repository that reached that count. This confirms both the thresholds and an important mechanic: the star count applies to a single repository, not a sum across all your repositories. Because stars come from other people, this badge is the hardest to engineer deliberately. Verified live on torvalds (Gold, all four thresholds present), ljharb (Gold), Schweinepriester (Gold), octocat (Gold), Rongronggg9 (Silver) and brannon (Bronze).
achievements.descriptionZh: Starstruck 表彰那些被其他开发者认为有价值、值得加 star 的、你亲手创建的仓库。GitHub 的实时徽章历史会明确列出 star 门槛，形式为「16 stars」「128 stars」「512 stars」「4096 stars」，每一条都链接到达到该数量的具体仓库。这同时确认了门槛数值和一个重要机制：star 数作用于单个仓库，而不是你所有仓库的 star 总和。由于 star 来自他人，这枚徽章最难刻意刷取。已在 torvalds（黄金，四个门槛齐全）、ljharb（黄金）、Schweinepriester（黄金）、octocat（黄金）、Rongronggg9（白银）、brannon（青铜）等账号上验证。
achievements.conditionEn: GitHub's own wording (from the live badge detail): "@<user> created a repository that has many stars." Milestones named by GitHub in the badge history: 16, 128, 512 and 4096 stars, on one repository you created.
achievements.conditionZh: GitHub 官方措辞（来自徽章详情页）：「@<用户名> created a repository that has many stars.」GitHub 在徽章历史中标注的里程碑：16、128、512、4096 颗 star，作用于你创建的某一个仓库。

tiers.note: Confirmed from GitHub's live badge history row '16 stars' linking to the qualifying repository (present on ~54 harvested profiles).

achievements.confidenceNote: All four thresholds appear verbatim as star counts in GitHub's own live badge history, with links to the qualifying repositories. The single-repository rule is stated in that same data.

achievements.summaryEn: Awarded for co-authoring commits on merged pull requests. Tiers: 1 (default), 10 (Bronze x2), 24 (Silver x3), 48 (Gold x4).
achievements.summaryZh: 在已合并的拉取请求中作为共同作者（co-author）时解锁。等级：1（默认）、10（青铜 x2）、24（白银 x3）、48（黄金 x4）。
achievements.descriptionEn: Pair Extraordinaire rewards collaboration: commits that credit another person with a Co-authored-by trailer, inside pull requests that get merged. GitHub's own badge wording is '@<user> coauthored commits on merged pull requests.' Unlike Pull Shark, Starstruck, Galaxy Brain and Finishing Touch, GitHub does NOT publish numeric milestones for this badge — the live history rows read only 'Coauthored with an unknown user' and each links to a co-authored PR. So the four thresholds come from the community catalogs, not from GitHub's own text, and are marked credibility C accordingly. What IS confirmed by GitHub directly is that the badge has exactly four levels (the live detail markup exposes a tier-count of 4 and per-tier badge images), and that GitHub records unlocks as 'Bronze' / 'Bronze and Silver' / 'Bronze and Silver' / Gold depending on level. Verified live on ljharb (Gold), octocat (Gold), mojombo (Gold), timrogers (Gold), Rongronggg9 (Gold), brannon (Silver), Schweinepriester (Silver).
achievements.descriptionZh: Pair Extraordinaire 奖励协作：在被合并的拉取请求中，使用 Co-authored-by 尾注把提交归属给另一位合作者。GitHub 官方措辞为「@<用户名> coauthored commits on merged pull requests.」与 Pull Shark、Starstruck、Galaxy Brain、Finishing Touch 不同，GitHub 并未为这枚徽章公布数字里程碑——实时历史行只显示「Coauthored with an unknown user」，并链接到相应的共同作者 PR。因此这四个门槛来自社区目录而非 GitHub 自身文本，故对应门槛的可信度标为 C。可以由 GitHub 直接确认的是：该徽章确实有且仅有四个等级（实时详情页标记中 tier-count 为 4，并提供各等级徽章图片），且 GitHub 会按等级记录解锁为「Bronze」「Bronze and Silver」或 Gold。已在 ljharb（黄金）、octocat（黄金）、mojombo（黄金）、timrogers（黄金）、Rongronggg9（黄金）、brannon（白银）、Schweinepriester（白银）上验证。
achievements.conditionEn: GitHub's own wording (from the live badge detail): "@<user> coauthored commits on merged pull requests." GitHub publishes no numeric milestones for this badge; the badge history lists the co-authored pull requests instead. Thresholds 1 / 10 / 24 / 48 are community-sourced.
achievements.conditionZh: GitHub 官方措辞（来自徽章详情页）：「@<用户名> coauthored commits on merged pull requests.」GitHub 未为该徽章公布数字里程碑，徽章历史中列出的是各条共同作者 PR。门槛 1 / 10 / 24 / 48 来自社区来源。

tiers.note: Community-sourced. GitHub confirms a base (unlabeled) tier exists and awards it, but does not print '1st co-authored PR merged' the way it prints milestone rows for the other four tiered badges.
Community-sourced (Schweinepriester + nmloc catalogs, which agree). GitHub's live unlock label 'Bronze' confirms the tier exists and is awarded, but GitHub does not print the number 10.
Community-sourced (Schweinepriester + nmloc catalogs, which agree). GitHub's live unlock label 'Bronze and Silver' confirms the tier exists and is awarded, but GitHub does not print the number 24.
Community-sourced (Schweinepriester + nmloc catalogs, which agree). GitHub's live tier label 'x4' confirms the tier exists and is awarded, but GitHub does not print the number 48.

achievements.confidenceNote: Availability and the four-level structure are confirmed by GitHub's own live pages (tier-count=4, per-tier badge art, unlock labels 'Bronze' / 'Bronze and Silver'). The specific numbers 10/24/48 are NOT printed anywhere by GitHub and are corroborated only by two independent community catalogs that agree with each other, hence grade C for the thresholds.

achievements.summaryEn: Awarded when answers you write in GitHub Discussions are accepted. Tiers: 2 (default), 8 (Bronze x2), 16 (Silver x3), 32 (Gold x4) accepted answers.
achievements.summaryZh: 你在 GitHub Discussions 中写的回答被采纳时解锁。等级：2（默认）、8（青铜 x2）、16（白银 x3）、32（黄金 x4）个被采纳的回答。
achievements.descriptionEn: Galaxy Brain celebrates helpful answers in GitHub Discussions. GitHub's live badge history names the milestones directly as '2nd accepted answer', '8th accepted answer', '16th accepted answer' and '32nd accepted answer', so the four thresholds are read directly from GitHub's own data. GitHub's official badge wording is '@<user> answered discussions.' One critical scope caveat: since 2024-02-06 GitHub has turned off the ability to earn Achievements inside GitHub's own Community Discussions (github.com/orgs/community) to counter spam; accepted answers in every other public repository's Discussions still count. Verified live on ljharb (Gold, all four thresholds), Schweinepriester (Bronze), timrogers (default), dylanatsmith (default), Rongronggg9 (default).
achievements.descriptionZh: Galaxy Brain 表彰在 GitHub Discussions 中提供的有帮助的回答。GitHub 的实时徽章历史直接标明里程碑：「2nd accepted answer」「8th accepted answer」「16th accepted answer」「32nd accepted answer」，因此四个门槛是从 GitHub 自身数据中直接读出的。GitHub 官方徽章措辞为「@<用户名> answered discussions.」有一个关键的范围限制：自 2024-02-06 起，GitHub 为打击刷徽章而关闭了在 GitHub 自家 Community Discussions（github.com/orgs/community）中赚取成就的能力；在其他所有公开仓库的 Discussions 中被采纳的回答仍然计入。已在 ljharb（黄金，四个门槛齐全）、Schweinepriester（青铜）、timrogers（默认）、dylanatsmith（默认）、Rongronggg9（默认）上验证。
achievements.conditionEn: GitHub's own wording (from the live badge detail): "@<user> answered discussions." Milestones named by GitHub in the badge history: the 2nd, 8th, 16th and 32nd accepted answer. NOTE: since 2024-02-06, accepted answers inside GitHub's own Community Discussions (github.com/orgs/community) do NOT count; answers in other public repositories' Discussions do.
achievements.conditionZh: GitHub 官方措辞（来自徽章详情页）：「@<用户名> answered discussions.」GitHub 在徽章历史中标注的里程碑：第 2、8、16、32 个被采纳的回答。注意：自 2024-02-06 起，GitHub 自家 Community Discussions（github.com/orgs/community）内的被采纳回答不再计入；其他公开仓库的 Discussions 中的回答仍然计入。

achievements.summaryEn: Awarded for pull requests that improve GitHub's own UI quality and get merged. Tiers: 1 (default), 4 (Bronze x2), 16 (Silver x3), 32 (Gold x4).
achievements.summaryZh: 改进 GitHub 自身界面质量且被合并的拉取请求。等级：1（默认）、4（青铜 x2）、16（白银 x3）、32（黄金 x4）。
achievements.descriptionEn: Finishing Touch is the narrowest of the tiered achievements: it counts merged pull requests that GitHub itself classifies as improving the quality of GitHub's user interface. GitHub's live badge history names the milestones precisely — '1st UI quality pull request merged', '4th UI quality pull request merged', '16th UI quality pull request merged', '32nd UI quality pull request merged' — so the four thresholds are confirmed directly from GitHub's own data. GitHub's official badge wording is "@<user> authored merged pull requests that improved GitHub's UI quality." Verified live on dylanatsmith (Gold x4, with all four thresholds present). IMPORTANT UNCERTAINTY: whether this badge can be earned by contributors outside GitHub is unresolved. An open GitHub Community question (2026-10-22) asks exactly this, and GitHub has published no eligibility statement naming qualifying repositories or PR classifications. Community reports mention Primer repositories as a possibility but that is not an official statement.
achievements.descriptionZh: Finishing Touch 是所有带等级成就中最「窄」的一枚：它统计的是被 GitHub 自己判定为「提升了 GitHub 界面质量」的已合并拉取请求。GitHub 的实时徽章历史精确标注了里程碑——「1st UI quality pull request merged」「4th UI quality pull request merged」「16th UI quality pull request merged」「32nd UI quality pull request merged」——因此四个门槛可直接从 GitHub 自身数据确认。GitHub 官方徽章措辞为「@<用户名> authored merged pull requests that improved GitHub's UI quality.」已在 dylanatsmith（黄金 x4，四个门槛齐全）上验证。重要不确定点：本徽章能否由 GitHub 外部贡献者获得尚无定论。GitHub Community 上有一个开放提问（2026-10-22）正是在问这件事，而 GitHub 从未发布过说明哪些仓库或哪类 PR 算数的资格声明。社区报告中提到 Primer 仓库，但这并非官方说法。
achievements.conditionEn: GitHub's own wording (from the live badge detail): "@<user> authored merged pull requests that improved GitHub's UI quality." Milestones named by GitHub in the badge history: the 1st, 4th, 16th and 32nd UI quality pull request merged. Whether non-GitHub contributors can qualify is NOT documented by GitHub.
achievements.conditionZh: GitHub 官方措辞（来自徽章详情页）：「@<用户名> authored merged pull requests that improved GitHub's UI quality.」GitHub 在徽章历史中标注的里程碑：第 1、4、16、32 个 UI quality 已合并 PR。GitHub 官方文档并未说明非 GitHub 贡献者是否具备获得资格。

tiers.note: Confirmed from GitHub's live badge history row '1st UI quality pull request merged' (dylanatsmith).

However the badge is rare and GitHub has never documented which repositories or PR classifications qualify, nor whether external contributors are eligible, so overall confidence on the practical earnability is B.

achievements.summaryEn: Awarded for closing an issue or pull request within 5 minutes of opening it. Single tier, no Bronze/Silver/Gold levels.
achievements.summaryZh: 在发起 issue 或 pull request 后 5 分钟内将其关闭即可获得。仅一个等级，没有青铜/白银/黄金分级。
achievements.descriptionEn: Quickdraw — GitHub's own badge tagline is literally 'Gitty up!' — is a single-tier achievement for closing an issue or pull request within five minutes of opening it. GitHub's live badge history confirms the exact event with the row 'Closed within 5 minutes of opening'. Because it has exactly one level, the badge artwork does not change with tier and no x2/x3/x4 label appears; only the default image is served. You may close your own issue or pull request. The badge artwork also ships in emoji skin-tone variants, chosen from the emoji skin-tone preference in Appearance Settings. Verified live on 41 harvested profiles including ljharb, Schweinepriester, egoist, shadcn, simonw, steipete and yyx990803.
achievements.descriptionZh: Quickdraw 的 GitHub 官方徽章标语就是「Gitty up!」，这是一枚单等级成就：在发起 issue 或 pull request 后 5 分钟内关闭它。GitHub 的实时徽章历史用「Closed within 5 minutes of opening」这一行精确确认了触发事件。由于只有一个等级，徽章图片不随等级变化，也不会出现 x2/x3/x4 标签，官方只提供默认等级图片。你也可以关闭自己发起的 issue 或 pull request。徽章另有按肤色区分的变体，可在外观设置中的 emoji 肤色偏好里选择。已在 41 个采集到的账号上验证，包括 ljharb、Schweinepriester、egoist、shadcn、simonw、steipete、yyx990803。
achievements.conditionEn: GitHub's own wording (from the live badge detail): the badge tagline is "Gitty up!" and the history row reads "Closed within 5 minutes of opening". One event unlocks it; there are no higher tiers.
achievements.conditionZh: GitHub 官方措辞（来自徽章详情页）：徽章标语为「Gitty up!」，历史行显示「Closed within 5 minutes of opening」。完成一次即解锁，没有更高等级。

tiers.note: Confirmed from GitHub's live badge history row 'Closed within 5 minutes of opening' (21 harvested profiles show this exact row). Single tier only — GitHub serves no bronze/silver/gold artwork for this badge.

achievements.confidenceNote: Condition is quoted verbatim from GitHub's own live badge history and confirmed across 21 harvested profiles. Single-tier structure confirmed by the absence of tier labels and by the fact that only the default image is served on GitHub's CDN.

achievements.summaryEn: Awarded for merging a pull request without a code review. Single tier, no Bronze/Silver/Gold levels.
achievements.summaryZh: 在没有代码评审的情况下合并拉取请求即可获得。仅一个等级，没有青铜/白银/黄金分级。
achievements.descriptionEn: YOLO — GitHub's own tagline is 'You want it? You merge it.' — is a single-tier achievement awarded for merging a pull request that received no code review. GitHub's live badge history confirms the trigger with the row 'Merged without a review'. The usual route is opening a pull request on your own repository and merging it yourself without waiting for a reviewer, which is why the community describes this one as requiring '1 user and 1 reviewer' via the Collaborating flow. Only the default artwork is served; there are no tier levels or x2/x3/x4 labels. Verified live on 41 harvested profiles including ljharb, Schweinepriester, egoist, shadcn, simonw, steipete and yyx990803. Note: because YOLO rewards merging unreviewed code, it is only appropriate on repositories you own or where you have explicit permission — merging unreviewed code into a shared project without permission is a bad practice regardless of the badge.
achievements.descriptionZh: YOLO 的 GitHub 官方标语是「You want it? You merge it.」，这是一枚单等级成就，用于表彰在没有收到代码评审的情况下合并拉取请求。GitHub 的实时徽章历史用「Merged without a review」这一行确认了触发条件。常见做法是在自己的仓库上开一个 pull request 然后自行合并，不必等待评审，因此社区把它描述为通过 Collaborating 流程实现「1 user + 1 reviewer」。官方只提供默认等级图片，没有等级分级与 x2/x3/x4 标签。已在 41 个采集到的账号上验证，包括 ljharb、Schweinepriester、egoist、shadcn、simonw、steipete、yyx990803。提醒：YOLO 奖励的是合并未经评审的代码，因此只应在你自己的仓库、或你明确获得许可的场景中使用——在共享项目里未经许可合并未评审代码，无论徽章与否都是糟糕做法。

achievements.descriptionEn: Heart On Your Sleeve was an experimental GitHub achievement intended for reacting to something on GitHub with a heart emoji. It was never broadly released. On 2026-03-27 a GitHub backend incident briefly re-enabled it together with Open Sourcerer, which caused them to appear on profiles across the site; GitHub staff then removed them again within days and stated that both achievements 'were part of an experimental rollout and were not meant to be broadly available'. No official criteria were ever published, and community trackers still carry '(???)' for its criteria. Because GitHub deleted its own artwork for this badge, the only surviving copies of the official artwork are community mirrors — the URL above is pinned to a specific immutable commit in the MIT-licensed Schweinepriester archive, so it cannot change or vanish. The tier numbers 16 and 128 for Bronze and Silver are community-derived; the default and Gold thresholds are unknown (the community catalog shows '???').

notes:
CRITICAL FRAMING FOR A SITE BUILDER — there is no official list of GitHub achievements, and there never has been since the 2022-06-09 public beta. Everything below is what I actually verified.

(1) THE OFFICIAL DOCS PAGE DOES NOT LIST ACHIEVEMENTS. https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference (HTTP 200) contains exactly two relevant sections: 'Displaying badges on your profile' (a table of 5 program BADGES, not achievements: Developer Program Member, Pro, Security Bug Bounty Hunter, GitHub Campus Expert, Security advisory credit) and 'Earning Achievements' (about 60 words describing the feature generically, with no achievement names, no conditions and no thresholds). I also checked the docs repo's git history: the file content of personalizing-your-profile.md at revisions ea6ecc68a (2022-10-19), abe4fc461 (2023-02-01), 1daed5cad (2023-03-03), c993a9138 (2023-06-01) and d7341440a (2022-06-23) contains ZERO occurrences of Pull Shark / Quickdraw / YOLO / Galaxy Brain / Starstruck / Public Sponsor / Pair Extraordinaire / Finishing Touch / Heart On Your Sleeve / Open Sourcerer / Proxima. GitHub's 2022 blog post says outright: 'What achievements are there? Great question, we'll never tell'. Do not attribute any per-achievement list to GitHub Docs.

(2) THE ONLY AUTHORITATIVE SOURCE OF NAMES, CONDITIONS AND THRESHOLDS IS THE LIVE PROFILE PAGE. Two undocumented endpoints expose everything: (a) GET https://github.com/users/<login>/achievements/<slug>/detail?hovercard=1 with the header 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' returns an HTML fragment containing the badge's GitHub-written description, the tier badge images, the unlock date, and a history whose rows NAME each threshold (e.g. '2nd pull request merged', '16 stars', '2nd accepted answer', '1st UI quality pull request merged', 'Closed within 5 minutes of opening', 'Merged without a review', '1st sponsorship'); (b) GET https://github.com/users/<login>?tab=achievements returns the badge images and the x2/x3/x4 tier labels. Without the XHR header the detail endpoint returns HTTP 406, so a site builder scraping it must set that header. IMPORTANT: these are undocumented, unsupported, subject to change, and the REST/GraphQL APIs do NOT expose achievements at all — I confirmed there is no 'Achievement' type in GitHub's published GraphQL schema (src/graphql/data/fpt/schema-users.json). Only the unrelated profile HIGHLIGHTS are in GraphQL, via User boolean fields isDeveloperProgramMember, isBountyHunter, isCampusExpert and isGitHubStar. If your site wants live per-user badges it must scrape HTML, not call the API.

(3) THE COMPLETE SET IS 15 ACHIEVEMENTS. Harvesting ~130 real profiles surfaced exactly 13 slugs (pull-shark, starstruck, pair-extraordinaire, galaxy-brain, finishing-touch, quickdraw, yolo, public-sponsor, arctic-code-vault-contributor, mars-2020-contributor, proxima-pioneer, proxima-staffshipper, proxima-staffuser) plus the 2 that GitHub switched off (heart-on-your-sleeve, open-sourcerer) = 15. This matches the nmloc/gh-achievements catalog (8 earnable, 2 switched off, 2 retired, 3 staff) and Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements exactly. I also found a 16th, historical item — the 'Discussion answered' profile BADGE (not an achievement), documented by GitHub until it was superseded by Galaxy Brain; I included it flagged DISCONTINUED so you do not accidentally publish it as current.

(4) TIER SYSTEM: 4 levels, named DEFAULT / BRONZE (x2) / SILVER (x3) / GOLD (x4). Badge art changes per level; the tier is a small coloured label. Tier label colours from the community catalog: Bronze x2 #F9BFA7, Silver x3 #E1E4E4, Gold x4 #FAE57E. Note the DEFAULT tier has no x-label — a user with only 2 merged PRs shows the base Pull Shark art with no label, while the DEFAULT artwork file still exists. Quickdraw, YOLO and Public Sponsor are single-tier with no x-labels and only default artwork served. Some badges (notably Starstruck and Quickdraw) also ship emoji skin-tone variants tied to the Appearance Settings preference.

(5) WHICH THRESHOLDS ARE ACTUALLY FIRST-HAND vs COMMUNITY. Confirmed verbatim from GitHub's own live history (grade A): Pull Shark 2/16/128/1024; Starstruck 16/128/512/4096; Galaxy Brain 2/8/16/32; Finishing Touch 1/4/16/32. NOT printed by GitHub anywhere (grade C, community only, three independent catalogs agree): Pair Extraordinaire 1/10/24/48 — GitHub's history rows for this badge read only 'Coauthored with an unknown user' and never a number, and GitHub's counting rule for co-authorship is genuinely not public (nmloc reports API counts of Co-authored-by PRs disagreeing with the tier by a wide margin). Heart On Your Sleeve 16/128 (default and Gold unknown, catalogs show '???') and Open Sourcerer 8/16/64 (default unknown). If your site states a threshold, label Pair Extraordinaire / Heart On Your Sleeve / Open Sourcerer numbers as community-sourced, and never invent a default or Gold number for the two disabled badges.

(6) THINGS GITUB HAS QUIETLY CHANGED — build these into the site's copy. (a) 2024-02-06: GitHub turned OFF earning Achievements inside GitHub's own Community Discussions (github.com/orgs/community) because of a 134% surge in spam posts, and the badge was earned at 566% the rate of the next-highest granting repo. Official announcement: community discussion #106536 (github-staff). Existing badges and progress were explicitly NOT removed. This change applies ONLY to github.com/orgs/community — accepted answers in every other public repo's Discussions still earn Galaxy Brain. (b) 2026-03-27: a backend incident accidentally re-enabled the never-released Heart On Your Sleeve and Open Sourcerer, so they flashed across profiles site-wide for a few days; GitHub staff removed them again and confirmed they 'were part of an experimental rollout and were not meant to be broadly available' (discussion #190909, staff reply 2026-03-29; incident thread #190842). As of 2026-10 they still cannot be earned (discussion #210634). (c) 2022-06-09: GitHub overhauled its achievement set, renaming 'GitHub Sponsor' -> 'Public Sponsor' and 'Mars 2020 Helicopter Contributor' -> 'Mars 2020 Contributor', and redesigning the artwork. (d) The 'Discussion answered' profile badge was replaced by the Galaxy Brain achievement (github/docs issue #25069). (e) GitHub retired the Discussion answered badge and removed it from the docs table, which now lists 5 program badges.

(7) THE CONTRIBUTIONS GRAPH IS A SEPARATE SYSTEM — do not conflate them. Achievements are not contribution-graph squares. Opening/answering a discussion still counts toward the graph even where it no longer earns an achievement. Separately, the 'Show Achievements on my profile' setting (https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/how-tos/contribution-settings/manage-visibility-settings-for-private-contributions-and-achievements) does two independent things: it shows anonymized private activity as numbers on the contribution calendar, and it controls whether badges are displayed at all. There is a common myth that you must enable it for private activity to COUNT toward achievements — the official page does not say that, and the community evidence indicates private-repo merged PRs do count toward Pull Shark (GitHub's own badge history lists private-repo milestones as 'inaccessible' but counted). Treat 'does the toggle affect counting?' as UNRESOLVED and do not make a claim either way.

(8) PUBLIC-SPONSOR SEMANTICS ARE SUBTLE. GitHub's badge wording changes with state: '@<user> is sponsoring N organizations or users.' while active, versus '@<user> has sponsored N organizations or users.' once past. Only PUBLIC sponsorships qualify.

(9) THE API DOES NOT EXPOSE ACHIEVEMENTS — but it does expose their ingredients, so a site can estimate progress. For Pull Shark, the search API 'is:pr is:merged author:<login>' is a close but LOW-biased approximation of the true counter (GitHub's own cumulative counter does not decrement when a repo is deleted or made private, so the gap grows with volume — observed gaps of 0 at the 2nd PR, 1 at the 16th, 2 at the 128th, 15 at the 1024th). Starstruck must be counted on a SINGLE repository, not summed across the account. Pair Extraordinaire cannot be counted reliably from the API at all, so show the tier only.

(10) ASSET URLS. All 28 official GitHub badge PNGs (13 achievements x up to 4 tiers) were individually fetched and returned HTTP 200 with real byte sizes, and the exact URLs match the nmloc catalog byte-for-byte. Format: https://github.githubassets.com/assets/<slug>-<default|bronze|silver|gold>-<hash>.png — note the hash suffix, so do NOT construct URLs by string substitution without the hash. The 8 tier art files for the two disabled badges are GONE from GitHub's CDN (GitHub deleted them), so those two entries point at a community mirror pinned to an immutable commit (549ba7291ccb68efcff5daf8af8c2c0ac6817b6f) in the MIT-licensed Schweinepriester repo; all 8 were confirmed present via the GitHub API. Also note the docs' own badge images are SVG octicons rendered inline, not PNG assets, so program badges have no stable CDN image URL.

(11) RARITY. Across ~130 harvested profiles: Arctic Code Vault Contributor appeared on 54, Pull Shark 54, Starstruck 54, Pair Extraordinaire 52, Quickdraw 41, YOLO 41, Public Sponsor 23, Galaxy Brain 21, Mars 2020 Contributor 6, and Finishing Touch and the three Proxima badges on exactly 1 each. Finishing Touch is therefore extremely rare, and its eligibility for non-GitHub contributors is an OPEN QUESTION with no official answer (community discussion #211041, 2026-10-22) — do not promise outsiders a path to it.

(12) SAFETY/ETHICS NOTE worth carrying into the site copy: GitHub treats coordinated badge farming as abuse and has terminated accounts over it (explicit threats listed in the #106536 announcement: content removal, blocking, suspension, termination). Do not publish 'badge farming' scripts or tutorials.
